Why schools and offices choose Plusmark

    GST invoice, delivery tracking and a real person on call for installations and repeat orders.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

Talk to us
Do you make custom board sizes?

Yes. Boards are cut to order for walls and rooms that do not match standard sizes. Share the width and height and we will quote the closest practical size.

Do you supply schools and offices in bulk?

Yes. Send a quantity list and delivery PIN codes for a bulk quotation with GST invoice and staged dispatch if needed.

How is the board packed?

Boards travel in edge-protected cartons. Large sizes are crated, and every order includes a tracking reference.

Stay in touch

A better board, one email at a time

New ranges, size guides and institutional offers. No daily noise; unsubscribe in one click.
